source: EHC_Checker_RULE_SET_v4_7.docx Part H1 — I.11 dairy establishment approval numbers

entries.name: Gregory Distribution, 280 Ernesettle Lane, Plymouth, Devon, PL5 2SA, United Kingdom
entries.notes: Loading/logistics only. Rare alternate I.13 depot (roughly every 6 months) for Saputo Davidstow (GB CQ 501) cheese exports, alongside North Tawton and Cullompton. I.11 Place of dispatch remains Davidstow (GB CQ 501) regardless of loading depot. Added v4.6.

entries.name: Gregory Distribution Ltd, Saunders Way, Cullompton, EX15 1BS
entries.notes: Loading/logistics only. Confirmed occasional alternate I.13 depot for the Saputo Davidstow (GB CQ 501) cheese lane specifically (Ingredient Solutions Ltd / Rosslare route). Not used on the SWP/whey powder (Novades) lane, which continues via Purfleet, Felixstowe and Heathfield. Added v4.6.

entries.name: Gregory Distribution Ltd, North Tawton (Cat 3 transport approval)
entries.notes: Transport/logistics approval — Cat 3 only. Applies to ANY consignor's 8322 Cat 3 load dispatched via this depot, not to one consignor's lane. Confirmed on Saputo/Davidstow and on AFI Variolac WPP / Bech Gruppen (Immingham–Esbjerg lane). Not the I.11 entry for AFI powder loads — see the N/A entry below. Scope clarified v4.7; CORRECTED v4.8 — the previous 'Saputo/Davidstow only' wording produced false hard errors on other consignors using the same depot.

entries.name: Gregory Distribution Ltd, North Tawton, Devon, EX20 2EB (AFI Taw Valley powder loads)
entries.notes: Standard I.11 for AFI Taw Valley powder loads — bagged/palletised, identified by I.27 Type of packaging ≠ BULK TANKER. Loading/logistics only. Distinct from AFI bulk tanker loads, where I.11 = Taw Valley Creamery, GB DE 030 (see E73), and from the Cat 3 transport approval U1183488/TRANS above. Key this entry on I.27 packaging type, never on trailer type. Added v4.7.

entries.name: Dairy Crest Ltd / Saputo Dairy UK, Davidstow, Camelford, Cornwall
Arla Foods Ingredients Taw Valley Limited / Taw Valley Creamery, South Weeke, North Tawton
Trewithen Dairy, Cornwall

entries.name: Gregory's Distribution Ltd, Heathfield (loading depot for Davidstow/Saputo)
entries.notes: Loading/logistics only — not a manufacturing establishment. Saputo/Davidstow use. This is ONE of two distinct roles at the same physical site; see the AFI Cat 3 dispatch entry below. Role clarified v4.8.

entries.name: Gregory's Distribution Ltd, Heathfield, Power Park, Old Newton Road, TQ12 6RF (AFI Taw Valley Cat 3 powder dispatch)
entries.notes: Same physical site as the Saputo/Davidstow loading depot above, different role: occasional ALTERNATE I.11 dispatch depot for AFI Taw Valley Cat 3 powder loads (bagged / bulk-bag, NOT bulk tanker). Not the default AFI depot — North Tawton remains standard. Do not flag when seen. Added v4.8; supersedes the former claim that no Cat 3 approval number exists at Heathfield, which was false for this AFI use case.

entries.name: County Milk Products Ltd, Dean Court, 85 Adlington Road, Wilmslow, Cheshire, SK9 2BT
entries.notes: I.1 consignor only — I.11 will be Dairy Crest/Davidstow (GB CQ 501). County Milk may also appear as I.5 consignee (self-account transfer to NI storage, I.1=I.5) on the County Milk → Leprino Foods NI lane, Belfast XIBEL1-DAERA. Confirmed repeat pattern (26/2/186272, 26/2/201696). Standing pass — do not flag. Added v4.6.
